name: Unmaker, Doom Engine
body:
UNMAKER, DOOM ENGINE
CR 14

XP 38,400
CE Huge outsider (native, psionic, unmaker)
Init –1; Senses darkvision 60 ft., lifesense 120 ft.; Perception +22; Aura impotence (20 ft., DC 23)

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 11, flat-footed 27 (+4 deflection, –1 Dex, +16 natural, –2 size)
hp 203 (14d10+126); regeneration 5
Fort +18, Ref +3, Will +14
Defensive Abilities destructive hide, ruinous shield; DR 10/-; Immune cold; PR 25
Weaknesses unstable resolve

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft., climb 50 ft., fly 20 ft. (poor)
Melee bite +24 (3d6+18 force damage plus grab)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks fast swallow, space-rending blows, swallow whole (8d6 force damage, 20 hp, AC 22), unimpeded advance
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 13th; concentration +18)

Constant—adapt body, energy adaptation, empathic feedback (DC 17, full damage), slip the bonds
At-Will—greater psychoport
3/day—kinetic crash (DC 17, 13d6, +17 bull rush, fly speed, explosion), kinetic redirection (DC 17, may use abilities as attack of opportunity or without spending action), summoning strike (DC 21, Large size)
1/day—null psionics fieldM

STATISTICS

Str 34, Dex 9, Con 28, Int 14, Wis 20, Cha 19
Base Atk +14; CMB +28 (+32 grapple); CMD 43 (51 vs. trip)
Feats Awesome Blow, Cornugon Smash, Furious Focus, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Vital Strike, Power Attack, Vital Strike
Skills Bluff +21, Intimidate +21, Knowledge (local) +19, Knowledge (planes) +19, Knowledge (psionics) +19, Perception +22, Sense Motive +22, Spellcraft +19
Languages telepathy 100 ft., truespeech
SQ no breath

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Destructive Hide (Ex)

The doom engine refracts force used upon it back onto the implements of its destruction.

Any creature that strikes the doom engine with a manufactured weapon in melee must succeed at a DC 21 Fortitude save or have their weapon take 2d6 points of force damage. If the creature strikes with a natural weapon or unarmed strike, they instead must save or take this damage. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Impotence Aura (Su)

Any creature within 20 feet of the doom engine must succeed at a DC 23 Fortitude save or become fatigued as well as a DC 23 Will save or become shaken for so long as it remains in the aura. A creature in the aura that is both fatigued and shaken (or is affected by a more severe version of either condition) is also considered flat-footed.

Unimpeded Advance (Ex)

A doom engine is unaffected by difficult terrain, reshaping itself as needed to continue moving.

ABOUT

Doom engines are designed to counter physically imposing foes, engaging them at close range and destroying their weapons while redirecting any damage taken. They are often employed as shock troops, storming heavy fortifications and breaking enemy lines.
